variants.headline: Still in view: full shelves, empty household purses
variants.sub: Households are hungry despite available food because they do not have the money to buy it.
variants.body:
Food is for sale, but households cannot afford it and are going hungry beside full shelves. Coverage of this story continues; the original event remains the starting point for the questions examined here.

Inventory and purchasing power are separate sides of a transaction. Our assessment favours {target} over a verdict that confuses an adverse interpretation with an established fact.
